checksums.name: not_sum16_le_block_checksum
checksums.formula_detail: stored_u16_le = (~(sum of u16_le words over covered range)) & 0xffff; equivalently sum+stored == 0xffff mod 0x10000. Signedness of Ghidra short* accumulation does not change low-16 result.

Verify/read-back compare via same trampoline pattern; writer treats return 0 as success (sets result flag 1 if any copy verifies)
Save writer: sets magic/slot byte, computes ~sum16 at +0x59c, writes 4 redundant copies, verifies each
Save reader: tries 4 copies in order, checks '*' + ~sum16 + byte1<3; on total failure calls FUN_08008fe8 default-init

DMA/CpuSet-style zero fill (stack zero word as source, DMA control 0x85000000/0x81000000); used to clear RAM save buffers, not SRAM directly
Save-all coordinator: clamps param 0..4, for slot 0..2: FUN_0800917c(slot) load/repair, stores clamped byte to a RAM byte (*_DAT_0803414c, exact offset unresolved), FUN_080090f0(slot) flush

open_questions: Exact RAM mirror base address (0x02xxxxxx/0x03xxxxxx) of the 0x5a0 block: Ghidra DAT literals (_DAT_08009174, _DAT_080091e8, _DAT_08008b60, _DAT_080090a8) are unresolved in decompiled.c, so ram_addr is null throughout; the inferred tail sub-struct base sav+0x4ec (size 0xb0, ending at checksum) is static inference from sav byte patterns, not a resolved pointer value.

Semantics of almost all payload fields: cap-01 is a near-default save (only init constants nonzero; slots differ only in byte1+checksum), so no progression-dependent field can be named from this corpus. More mutated .sav captures are needed.

Discrepancy: FUN_08008fe8 writes 0xff via puVar1[0x4f] (inferred sav 0x58a, observed 0x00) and FUN_08008ee8(1,1) writes record byte (inferred sav 0x7f, observed 0x00) - either the inferred sub-struct base is off for those writes, or later gameplay/init steps cleared them before the flush captured in cap-01.

What FUN_08034d58's clamped 0..2 byte and FUN_0803411c's per-slot stored byte (*_DAT_0803414c) represent (difficulty? language? profile id?) - in cap-01 all slots carry identical payload, so the value's sav offset could not be isolated.

Whether slots are truly independent player profiles: FUN_0803411c rewrites ALL 3 slots from (apparently) the same RAM buffer on every save, and cap-01 slots are byte-identical except slot index - either this capture saved the same state 3x, or slots are not independent in the way geometry suggests.
func_0x0805ea54 trampoline body (SRAM read/verify core) is unrecovered (jumptable), so read/verify return-code semantics are inferred from callers only.
No .ss save states were provided (states/ empty), so no fuzzing prediction in section 6 has been executed; cold-reload probe in PACKET.md only confirms a non-blank save is retained/recognised.
